rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０２０Hey!￥A-are you okay...?＝＠１０６＿０２１Geez...￥Don't scare me like that!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０２２Collapsing out of nowhere...￥What were you thinking?!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０２３This is what happens when you￥don't take care of yourself!
No need to go that far.
I know that already.
That's a bit harsh.
I know that already.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０２４Then don't do things that make￥me say it!＝＠１０６＿０２５If you've got brains enough to￥talk back, use them to look￥after your own body!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０２６If you knew, you wouldn't have￥collapsed, would you?!＝＠１０６＿０２７You don't even know your own￥limits, so quit acting so cool!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００１Listen.￥Collapsing now is as good as￥giving up on going to Elan!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００２Nobody's going to trust someone￥who can't even look after￥themselves...＝＠１０７＿００３with something as big as the￥mission to explore Elan!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００４Overdoing it and wrecking your￥body only hurts you--as a￥candidate and as a person...
I'll be more careful.
None of your business!
I'll be more careful.
None of your business!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００５Rushing won't do you any good.
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００６Training won't stick unless you￥do it when you're in good shape!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００７You're such an idiot, I just￥couldn't keep my mouth shut!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００８But if you can talk big like￥that, maybe you're fine now!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿００９Don't even think about training￥until you're completely better!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿０１０I-it's not like I came because I￥was worried!＝＠１０７＿０１１Don't get the wrong idea, okay?!
＊Riko＊＠１０７＿０１２Well, get well soon!
